extras: Not an official Obsidian Sync service.
problem: Users need a reliable, two-way synchronization method to keep their local Obsidian vault consistent with external cloud storage services.

relations.evidence: Sync a vault with 360AI Cloud Disk (360AI云盘) in both directions.

summary: A two-way synchronization plugin that reliably sync Obsidian vaults with 360AI Cloud Disk, handling incremental changes, conflicts, and large files.
